thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — staging deprecation for /v1/stable-client -> /v2-stable-client is scheduled Wed 2024-11-06 18:00 UTC. Need clear owners for migration comms, SDK patches, runtime shims, and canary ops. Who can own which lane?
jon: I can take runtime-side compatibility + fallback rules. What’s our rollback window if canary shows issues? :thumbsup:
tara: SDK side — I’ll handle header changes and a small helper. Will open a PR today (tracking number will follow). ETA EOD tomorrow.
rahul: Infra note — we need proxy routing rules to accept legacy headers during the canary. That infra change is a blocker for the canary unless I get a deploy slot. I can target Mon morning for the gateway change.
liz: SRE will run the canary (start at 5% traffic) and run perf smoke + regression alerts. Need a short test plan and synthetic payloads.
maya: OK owners so far: jon (runtime), tara (SDK), rahul (infra), liz (SRE). @tara please add owner rows to the migration spreadsheet and update the runbook link.
tara: Added owner rows and initial checklist: https://our-company.docs/runbooks/stable-client-migration-4332 — included SDK checklist and changelog stub. @jon can you sanity-check runtime behavior for missing header case?
jon: Quick local verify: patch handles missing `Accept-Version` header by defaulting to v1 behavior. One edge-case: clients sending `X-Stable-Client: beta` will be treated as v1 — pushed a small shim fix to my branch to normalize that.
dev-bot: deploy-checklist: CI passed on jon/compat-shim, tara/sdk-834, rahul/proxy-routing. All green :white_check_mark:
maya: Two asks before freeze: 1) telemetry event name we’ll use to detect migration failures, 2) confirm deprecation announcement copy. Proposed telemetry event: `stable_client_migration.failure_count`.
liz: Telemetry team OK with that event; please also emit `stable_client_latency.p99` so SRE can alert on perf regressions during canary.
rahul: I'll add a canary feature-flag (2% initial) so we can toggle to 50% quickly if green. Will also draft a brief infra rollback runbook.
maya: I’ll draft the public deprecation notice and loop in marketing + support. Proposed cadence: 2-week customer notice, 4 weeks of header warnings, then cutover. Sound good?
tara: SDK PR will include `StableClient.migrate()` helper and example in README. Will call out the small header change in the changelog.
jon: Small doc ask @tara — can you add a canonical curl example using `-H "Accept-Version: v2"` so docs + SDK match?
tara: Yep, will add that example and a migration snippet in the README.
maya: Thanks everyone — I’ll update the owners doc and publish the rollout plan. If there are no objections we proceed: infra deploy Mon, SDK PR review Tue EOD, canary Wed. :rocket:
